message.jaymospowers.retired.reactor: The heart that beat in you was never its own power: it is the legendary fighter's rage. You wake again as a Z Fighter.
message.jaymospowers.retired.blinker: Your step between places was the void's own, taken through its rifts. You wake again with the Pocket Arsenal, and when the void takes you, the blinks come with it.
message.jaymospowers.retired.rules: The rules you wrote were never a power of their own: they are how a Paladin's oath and a Warlock's pact are written. Something else wakes in you.
